visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long brown hair, wearing a grey tweed dress, stands in a brightly lit indoor room. She holds a purple snake-like plush toy and speaks excitedly to the camera with expressive facial movements and hand gestures. (2) Transitions to bright green animated footage of a park with lush trees. A brown and tan bird creature flies across the screen. Text overlays appear at the bottom. (3) Returns to the woman; she is now holding a blue and white penguin plushie. She points upwards with her right index finger while maintaining direct eye contact with the camera. (4) Animated sequence shows a natural forest setting with multiple purple and brown creatures interacting in the grass under bright sunlight. (5) Another animated scene depicts a town square with a red-roofed building. A pink egg-shaped creature and a yellow duck-like creature are visible near a fountain. (6) The woman reappears, holding a black creature plushie with yellow rings. She moves the plushie closer to her face while speaking with emphasis. (7) A digital screen capture displays a text document regarding ticket information in Chinese and English. (8) An illustration of a massive tree populated by various small blue and purple creatures is shown. (9) A calendar interface for February 2026 and a ticket price list are displayed as a full-screen overlay. (10) The woman holds the black plushie again, gesturing toward the screen as text overlays about prices appear. (11) The woman holds a yellow creature plushie and adopts a more serious expression, using two fingers to emphasize a point about restrictions.
